species.real: The stinkhorn's slimy cap smells of rotting meat to draw flies, which eat the slime and carry off the spores. Its scientific name means 'shameless phallus'.
species.name: Whiffhorn

dex.text: You will smell it long before you see it, and once you've seen it you'll wish you'd stuck with the smell. It is not embarrassed about its shape. Everyone else is.
dex.fact: Gwen Raverat wrote that her Aunt Etty, Charles Darwin's daughter, hunted stinkhorns and burned them in secret, to protect the morals of the maids.
